progressionAfterOpen.visibleText:
Class tracks, combinations, and special pathsClass tracks, concurrent combinations, and sequential changes

These labels describe the progression represented by each guide. Check race, abilities, alignment, and campaign requirements in the cited rules before choosing a character’s classes.

Concurrent multiclass

PHB pp. 32–33 presents combinations operated at the same time by non-human or semi-human characters. The combinations available depend on race; this is a separate procedure from changing professions.

PHB pp. 32, 33
Sequential class change (dual-class)

PHB p. 33’s human-only profession change stops advancement in the former class. It requires principal attribute scores of at least 15 in the original class and 17 or 18 in the new class, with alignment restrictions. The character retains earlier hit points but begins the new class’s other functions at level 1. Former-class functions restrict new-class XP until the new level exceeds the old one.

PHB p. 33
